description.full_text: A clear glass bowl is filled with vibrant, dried orange, yellow, and red berries. Some of the berries have opened husks, revealing colorful interiors. A few loose berries are scattered at the base of the bowl. The overall mood is warm and autumnal, suggesting a decorative or natural theme.
